GAME OF CAT is a Solana memecoin inspired by a fantasy world of rival cat kingdoms, dragon queens, and battles for the crown.

$VTUBEPRO is the community token of VTube Pro, a free VTuber studio that runs in your browser: 3D and 2D avatars, face and body tracking from any webcam, live 3D rooms and stages, light shows, multiplayer guests, and one-click streaming to OBS.

What we're building for the token:
- Tips: viewers tip their favourite streamers in $VTUBEPRO, shown with its dollar value. Tips go straight from wallet to wallet; streamers can keep them or swap them for USDC, USDT or SOL in their own wallet.
- Holder perks: people who hold $VTUBEPRO and use VTube Pro unlock exclusive cosmetics such as special backgrounds, avatars and room items.
- The Marketplace: artists will sell avatars, environments and asset packs, with each purchase recorded on Solana as a permanent licence the artist can't take back. A free Marketplace of official VTube Pro rooms, characters and asset packs comes first.

VTube Pro is and will stay free to use. You never need the token to use the app. VTube Pro will never DM you first, never ask for your seed phrase, and never ask you to send it crypto.
